coverage.note: Partial dataset. 5 jurisdictions recorded of 27 EU member states plus UK and Norway in scope for v1. This is not a completeness claim: a jurisdiction absent from rows means not yet recorded, never 'no obligation'. See dataset/dist/coverage.md and dataset/CHANGELOG.md.

rows.bound_party: Taxable persons established in Belgium supplying goods or services to another VAT-identified taxable person. Excluded by the law itself: taxable persons subject to the flat-rate scheme of Article 56 of the VAT Code, and bankrupt taxable persons.
rows.threshold_definition: No size test. The obligation binds every established taxable person in scope regardless of turnover or headcount, which makes Belgium the strictest of the 2026 cohort for small companies — there is no small-company deferral to wait for.
rows.format_version: 3.0.21 mandatory on the Peppol network from 2026-08-17
rows.format_note: The law requires a structured electronic form permitting automatic processing and compliant with EN 16931-1 and CEN/TS 16931-2. The implementing royal decree sets Peppol BIS Billing in UBL syntax, transmitted over the Peppol network, as the default standard; parties may agree an alternative format provided it still complies with the European standard. The version figure is the OpenPeppol release calendar, verified separately at docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/release-notes/ — Peppol BIS Billing 3.0.21 was published 2026-05-20 and became mandatory 2026-08-17, superseding 3.0.20. Belgian law does not itself name a Peppol version, so the version moves on OpenPeppol's schedule, not Belgium's.
rows.tolerance_note: Penalty tolerance only — not a postponement of the obligation. FPS Finance will not apply penalties for offences relating to the new e-invoicing obligation during the first three months of 2026 where the enterprise can show it took reasonable steps to comply, including where it lacks the technical means to send structured electronic invoices or its software cannot yet issue a valid one. FPS Finance states explicitly that "under no circumstances" will a general postponement be granted.
rows.legal_instrument: Loi du 6 février 2024 modifiant le Code de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée et le Code des impôts sur les revenus 1992 en ce qui concerne l'introduction de l'obligation de facturation électronique, amending Article 53 of the VAT Code (Moniteur belge, 20 February 2024, numac 2024001635).
rows.source_title: Loi du 6 février 2024 — consolidated text as published in the Moniteur belge of 20 February 2024 (numac 2024001635), ejustice.just.fgov.be
rows.confidence_note: Gazette text read directly on 2026-10-07: the 1 January 2026 entry into force, the Article 56 and bankruptcy exclusions, the Article 44 and Article 135(1) scope carve-outs, and the EN 16931-1 / CEN/TS 16931-2 standard reference. The tolerance window and its penalties-only character were read the same day on the official einvoice.belgium.be portal (FPS Finance / BOSA). finances.belgium.be served a CAPTCHA to this host and was not used.
unknowns: The implementing royal decree that designates Peppol BIS Billing (UBL) as the default standard was not read directly; the format designation here is taken from the gazette's standard reference plus secondary description of the decree. The decree's own text, and whether it pins a Peppol BIS version, is unconfirmed.

Treatment of non-established taxable persons merely VAT-registered in Belgium is not recorded. The law binds persons "established in Belgium"; whether a foreign-established but Belgian-VAT-registered supplier is in or out is not established here.
rows.notes: Entry into force was conditional on EU Council authorisation under Article 395 of Directive 2006/112/EC. Out of scope per the law: supplies exempt under Article 44 of the VAT Code, and certain cross-border supplies under Article 135(1)(a)-(g) of Directive 2006/112/EC. VAT units are subject to different rules.

rows.bound_party: Taxable persons established in Belgium receiving B2B supplies, excluding those subject to the flat-rate scheme of Article 56 of the VAT Code and bankrupt taxable persons.
rows.threshold_definition: No size test; applies regardless of turnover or headcount.
rows.format_version: 3.0.21 mandatory on the Peppol network from 2026-08-17
rows.format_note: Must be able to receive an EN 16931-compliant structured invoice. Peppol BIS Billing (UBL) over the Peppol network is the default standard; an alternative EN 16931-compliant format may be agreed between the parties.
rows.tolerance_note: Same penalty tolerance as the issuing duty. FPS Finance names inability to receive structured electronic invoices as a covered offence for the first three months of 2026. The obligation itself is not postponed.
rows.legal_instrument: Loi du 6 février 2024 modifiant le Code de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée et le Code des impôts sur les revenus 1992 (Moniteur belge, 20 February 2024, numac 2024001635).
rows.source_title: Loi du 6 février 2024 — consolidated text as published in the Moniteur belge of 20 February 2024 (numac 2024001635), ejustice.just.fgov.be
rows.confidence_note: Gazette text read directly on 2026-10-07; tolerance read the same day on the official einvoice.belgium.be portal, which explicitly lists inability to receive among the tolerated offences.
unknowns: Whether a recipient may refuse a compliant structured invoice, or must accept one sent in an agreed alternative format, is not recorded.
rows.notes: Recorded separately from the issuing duty because "must I be able to receive yet?" is a different question from "must I issue yet?", even where the dates coincide. Same scope exclusions as BE-e-invoicing-b2b-issue-all.

rows.bound_party: Domestic entrepreneurs issuing an invoice for a supply to another domestic entrepreneur's business, whose total turnover (Gesamtumsatz, § 19 Abs. 2 UStG) in the preceding calendar year exceeded EUR 800,000.
rows.threshold_basis: Gesamtumsatz as defined in § 19 Abs. 2 UStG, of the entrepreneur issuing the invoice.
rows.threshold_definition: § 27 Abs. 38 UStG extends the tolerance to 31 December 2027 only "wenn der Gesamtumsatz (§ 19 Absatz 2) des die Rechnung ausstellenden Unternehmers im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr nicht mehr als 800 000 Euro" betragen hat. This row is the cohort that fails that test, i.e. prior-year turnover above EUR 800,000, for whom the tolerance ends a year earlier.
rows.format_version: ZUGFeRD 2.0.1 or later; XRechnung (current published version)
rows.format_note: BMF FAQ Q7: XRechnung and ZUGFeRD from version 2.0.1 satisfy the VAT requirements, excluding the MINIMUM and BASIC-WL profiles. Another format may be agreed between the parties if the UStG-required data can be extracted correctly and completely from it, which keeps EDI procedures such as EDIFACT usable.
rows.tolerance_note: From 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026 any issuer may issue a "sonstige Rechnung" instead of an e-invoice. Paper is always permitted; another electronic format such as a PDF by e-mail requires the recipient's consent. Separately, a non-conforming EDI procedure may be used until 31 December 2027 even by this cohort (BMF FAQ Q11).
rows.legal_instrument: § 14 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 UStG; transitional rule § 27 Abs. 38 UStG (Wachstumschancengesetz).
rows.source_title: § 27 Abs. 38 Umsatzsteuergesetz — consolidated text, gesetze-im-internet.de (BMJ / Bundesanzeiger Verlag)
rows.confidence_note: Statutory text of § 27 Abs. 38 UStG read directly on 2026-10-07, including the EUR 800,000 figure and the "vorangegangenes Kalenderjahr" measurement period. Cross-checked against BMF FAQ (Stand März 2026) Q11, which states the same dates in plain language.
rows.notes: Date is driven by when the supply is carried out (Zeitpunkt des Umsatzes), not when the invoice is raised: § 27 Abs. 38 UStG frames the tolerance as applying to a supply "nach dem 31. Dezember 2024 und vor dem 1. Januar 2027 ausgeführten Umsatz".

rows.bound_party: Domestic entrepreneurs issuing an invoice for a supply to another domestic entrepreneur's business, whose total turnover (Gesamtumsatz, § 19 Abs. 2 UStG) in the preceding calendar year was EUR 800,000 or less.
rows.threshold_basis: Gesamtumsatz as defined in § 19 Abs. 2 UStG, of the entrepreneur issuing the invoice.
rows.threshold_definition: § 27 Abs. 38 UStG: the tolerance runs to 31 December 2027 "wenn der Gesamtumsatz (§ 19 Absatz 2) des die Rechnung ausstellenden Unternehmers im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr nicht mehr als 800 000 Euro" betragen hat. Tested per year, so an entrepreneur crossing EUR 800,000 in 2026 loses the extra year for 2027 supplies.
rows.format_version: ZUGFeRD 2.0.1 or later; XRechnung (current published version)
rows.format_note: Same format set as the above-threshold cohort. BMF FAQ Q7: XRechnung and ZUGFeRD from version 2.0.1, excluding the MINIMUM and BASIC-WL profiles.
rows.tolerance_note: BMF FAQ Q11: "Bei einem Vorjahresumsatz des Rechnungsausstellers bis 800.000 Euro verlängert sich diese Frist noch bis zum Ablauf des Jahres 2027." Until then a sonstige Rechnung may be issued; paper always, other electronic formats with the recipient's consent.
rows.legal_instrument: § 14 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 UStG; transitional rule § 27 Abs. 38 UStG (Wachstumschancengesetz).
rows.source_title: § 27 Abs. 38 Umsatzsteuergesetz — consolidated text, gesetze-im-internet.de (BMJ / Bundesanzeiger Verlag)
rows.confidence_note: Statutory text read directly on 2026-10-07 ("bis zum 31. Dezember 2027 für einen nach dem 31. Dezember 2026 und vor dem 1. Januar 2028" ausgeführten Umsatz, conditional on the EUR 800,000 test). Cross-checked against BMF FAQ Q11.
unknowns: Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG) are exempt from the issuing obligation entirely per BMF FAQ Q4 and Q12, not merely deferred to 2028. That exemption is a separate row not yet recorded; until it exists, this row over-states the obligation for Kleinunternehmer.
rows.notes: Recorded alongside the above-threshold row deliberately: a threshold captured from only one side is a half-row and misleads anyone sitting near the boundary.

rows.bound_party: Every domestic entrepreneur (inländischer Unternehmer, § 2 UStG) acting in a business capacity, including small businesses (Kleinunternehmer), freelancers, and persons making only exempt supplies such as residential landlords and doctors.
rows.threshold_definition: No size, turnover or headcount threshold. BMF FAQ Q12: "Es sind keine Ausnahmen vorgesehen" — no exemptions are provided. Kleinunternehmer are exempt from issuing e-invoices but must still be able to receive them.
rows.format_note: No specific transmission channel is prescribed. BMF FAQ Q8 and Q12: holding an e-mail inbox is sufficient to satisfy the receiving obligation ("Dazu reicht bereits ein E-Mail-Postfach aus").
rows.tolerance_note: No transition period applies to receiving. The 1 Jan 2025 – 31 Dec 2026 tolerance in § 27 Abs. 38 UStG covers the issuing of invoices only, not their receipt (BMF FAQ Q11, Q12).
rows.legal_instrument: § 14 Abs. 1 and Abs. 2 Nr. 1 UStG as recast by the Wachstumschancengesetz, for supplies carried out after 31 December 2024. Administrative interpretation: BMF-Schreiben of 15 October 2024 (BStBl I S. 1320) and 15 October 2025.
rows.source_title: Bundesministerium der Finanzen — Fragen und Antworten zur Einführung der obligatorischen E-Rechnung zum 1. Januar 2025 (Stand: März 2026)
rows.confidence_note: BMF FAQ read directly on 2026-10-07; page carries "Stand: März 2026" and is dated 23.03.2026. Questions 8 and 12 state the receiving obligation and the absence of exemptions. Statutory definition cross-read in § 14 Abs. 1 UStG.
rows.notes: This is the row most German small vendors get wrong: they are not obliged to issue until 2027 or 2028, but they have been obliged to be able to receive since 1 January 2025, with no grace period.

rows.regime_label: Facturation électronique — domestic B2B e-invoicing reform
rows.bound_party: Grandes entreprises and entreprises de taille intermédiaire (ETI), plus any company that opted into the reform early. DGFiP: "À compter du 1er septembre 2026, les grandes entreprises et les entreprises de taille intermédiaire..."
rows.threshold_basis: Headcount leg of the PME test in article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354; must be read together with threshold_definition, because the real boundary is composite.
rows.threshold_period: the last closed accounting year, per the company-size categories of décret n° 2008-1354
rows.threshold_definition: In scope if the company is NOT a PME within the meaning of article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354. A PME employs fewer than 250 persons AND has either annual turnover not exceeding EUR 50 million or a balance-sheet total not exceeding EUR 43 million. So this row applies if the company employs 250 or more persons, OR employs fewer than 250 but exceeds both EUR 50 million turnover and EUR 43 million balance-sheet total. The headcount and financial tests are cumulative within the PME definition; the two financial criteria are alternatives to each other. Encoding this as a bare "250 employees" rule would wrongly exempt a 200-person company with EUR 60m turnover and a EUR 50m balance sheet.
rows.format_note: Factur-X, UBL and CII are the permitted structured formats; versions are not stated in the DGFiP guide read for this row. See unknowns.
rows.legal_instrument: Ordonnance n° 2021-1190 du 15 septembre 2021, as amended; company-size categories per article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354 du 18 décembre 2008.
rows.source_title: DGFiP, "Facturation électronique : guide pratique de démarrage au 1er septembre 2026", July 2026 (impots.gouv.fr)
rows.confidence_note: Two primary sources read on 2026-10-07. Dates from the DGFiP July 2026 practical guide. Size categories from article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354 on Legifrance, including the "moins de 250 personnes", "50 millions d'euros" and "43 millions d'euros" figures and the fact that the financial criteria are alternatives.
unknowns: Permitted format versions (Factur-X, UBL, CII) not stated in the source read.

Whether company size is assessed at group or at legal-entity level for this reform is not established. Décret n° 2008-1354 defines categories; which consolidation perimeter DGFiP applies for e-invoicing scope was not found.
The accompanying e-reporting duty for this cohort is not yet recorded as its own row.
rows.notes: threshold_value 250 is the headcount leg only. Any consumer rendering this row must show threshold_definition alongside it, or it will give a wrong answer to mid-sized companies. The ETI upper bound (fewer than 5,000 persons, turnover up to EUR 1,500m or balance-sheet total up to EUR 2,000m) does not affect scope here, because grandes entreprises are caught on the same date.

rows.regime_label: Facturation électronique — domestic B2B e-invoicing reform
rows.bound_party: PME, TPE and micro-entreprises that did not opt into the reform early. DGFiP: "Pour les PME, TPE et micro-entreprises, cette obligation d'émission s'applique à compter du 1er septembre 2027."
rows.threshold_basis: Headcount leg of the PME test in article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354; read with threshold_definition.
rows.threshold_period: the last closed accounting year, per the company-size categories of décret n° 2008-1354
rows.threshold_definition: In scope if the company IS a PME within the meaning of article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354: fewer than 250 persons employed AND either annual turnover not exceeding EUR 50 million or a balance-sheet total not exceeding EUR 43 million. Micro-entreprise, a subset: fewer than 10 persons and turnover or balance-sheet total not exceeding EUR 2 million.
rows.format_note: Factur-X, UBL and CII are the permitted structured formats; versions are not stated in the DGFiP guide read for this row. See unknowns.
rows.legal_instrument: Ordonnance n° 2021-1190 du 15 septembre 2021, as amended; company-size categories per article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354 du 18 décembre 2008.
rows.source_title: DGFiP, "Facturation électronique : guide pratique de démarrage au 1er septembre 2026", July 2026 (impots.gouv.fr)
rows.confidence_note: DGFiP guide read on 2026-10-07, which states the 1 September 2027 issuing date for PME, TPE and micro-entreprises and confirms such a company may opt in early. Size categories read the same day in article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354 on Legifrance.
unknowns: Permitted format versions (Factur-X, UBL, CII) not stated in the source read.
No tolerance or penalty-grace window for this cohort was found in the guide. Absence of a found tolerance is not proof none exists.
rows.notes: This cohort is still bound to RECEIVE from 1 September 2026 — see FR-e-invoicing-b2b-receive-all. A consumer that renders only this row for a small French company will understate its 2026 obligation by a full year.

rows.regime_label: Facturation électronique — domestic B2B e-invoicing reform
rows.bound_party: All companies within the scope of the reform, regardless of size. DGFiP: "toutes les entreprises concernées par la réforme doivent avoir la capacité de recevoir des factures électroniques dès le 1er septembre 2026."
rows.threshold_definition: No size test on the receiving duty. This is the fact most French SMEs get wrong: the widely-quoted "September 2027 for SMEs" date is the ISSUING date only. A micro-entreprise must be able to receive a year earlier, because large enterprises and ETI start issuing to it on 1 September 2026.
rows.format_note: Three structured formats are permitted under the reform — Factur-X, UBL and CII. The DGFiP practical guide read for this row names the reform's framework but does not state version numbers, and the "spécifications externes" document that carries them was not retrieved. Format versions are an open unknown on this row, not an omission.
rows.legal_instrument: Ordonnance n° 2021-1190 du 15 septembre 2021 relative à la généralisation de la facturation électronique, as amended; calendar as stated by DGFiP in its July 2026 practical guide.
rows.source_title: DGFiP, "Facturation électronique : guide pratique de démarrage au 1er septembre 2026", Direction générale des Finances publiques, July 2026 (impots.gouv.fr)
rows.confidence_note: DGFiP guide PDF retrieved and read in full on 2026-10-07. It states the 1 September 2026 reception date for all companies in scope, and confirms the statutory calendar is being maintained ("le maintien du calendrier légal"). Reception runs through an approved platform (Plateforme Agréée).
unknowns: Permitted format versions (Factur-X, UBL, CII) are not stated in the DGFiP guide read; the "spécifications externes" document carrying them was not retrieved.

The ordonnance article numbers were not read on Legifrance this cycle. The dates come from DGFiP, a primary tax-authority source, but the statutory citation should be confirmed before it is quoted to a customer as a legal reference.
The e-reporting (transmission de données de transaction) obligation that accompanies the reform is not yet recorded as its own row.
rows.notes: impots.gouv.fr/facturation-electronique 302-redirects to collectivites-locales.gouv.fr and economie.gouv.fr returned HTTP 403 to this host, so the DGFiP guide PDF was the usable primary source.

rows.regime_label: Electronic invoicing via the Sistema di Interscambio (SdI)
rows.bound_party: Taxpayers applying the Italian flat-rate regime (regime forfetario, L. 190/2014 art. 1 cc. 54–89) who were not already required to issue electronic invoices from 1 July 2022 — i.e. those whose revenue or fees in the preceding year, pro-rated to a full year, did not exceed EUR 25,000.
rows.threshold_basis: Ricavi conseguiti ovvero compensi percepiti, ragguagliati ad anno (revenue earned or fees received, pro-rated to a full year).
rows.threshold_period: the year preceding the relevant commencement date
rows.threshold_definition: DL 36/2022 art. 18 c. 3 brought the obligation forward to 1 July 2022 for forfetario taxpayers who "nell'anno precedente abbiano conseguito ricavi ovvero percepito compensi, ragguagliati ad anno, superiori a euro 25.000". This row is the residual cohort at or below that figure, for whom the obligation runs from 1 January 2024 "a prescindere dall'entità dei ricavi conseguiti o compensi percepiti" — irrespective of revenue. So the threshold selects the commencement date, and from 1 January 2024 it no longer screens anyone out.
rows.format_name: FatturaPA XML, transmitted through the Sistema di Interscambio (SdI)
rows.format_note: National format, not EN 16931. Technical specifications v1.9 usable from 1 April 2025; v1.9.1 usable from 15 May 2026. Agenzia delle Entrate has published no date on which v1.9 ceases to be accepted by the SdI, so v1.9 is recorded as the current floor rather than v1.9.1.
rows.legal_instrument: DL 30 aprile 2022 n. 36, art. 18 cc. 2–3, which repealed the exemption in art. 1 c. 3 of D.Lgs. 5 agosto 2015 n. 127. Administrative interpretation: Agenzia delle Entrate Circolare n. 32/E of 5 December 2023.
rows.source_title: Decreto-legge 30 aprile 2022 n. 36, art. 18 — consolidated text in force, Normattiva (Istituto Poligrafico e Zecca dello Stato)
rows.confidence_note: Commi 2 and 3 of DL 36/2022 art. 18 read directly from the Normattiva consolidated "vigente" text on 2026-10-07, confirming both dates and the EUR 25,000 / ragguagliati ad anno wording. FatturaPA version dates read directly from the two Agenzia delle Entrate specification pages on 2026-10-07.
unknowns: Whether any penalty-free grace period applied to the 1 January 2024 cohort. The 1 July 2022 cohort had one under DL 36/2022 art. 18 c. 3 for the third quarter of 2022; no equivalent for 2024 was located in this pass.

The 'contribuenti minimi' (DL 98/2011 art. 27) and amateur sports bodies were covered by the same repealed exemption in art. 1 c. 3 D.Lgs. 127/2015, but were not separately verified here and have no row yet.
The date on which FatturaPA specification v1.9 stops being accepted by the SdI. Agenzia delle Entrate states only that v1.9.1 is 'utilizzabile' from 15 May 2026.
rows.notes: Italy's general SdI mandate dates from 1 January 2019; this row records only the final extension that pulled the smallest flat-rate taxpayers in. The 2019 general row and the 1 July 2022 cohort row are not yet recorded.

rows.regime_label: National e-Invoice System (KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur)
rows.bound_party: VAT taxpayers whose sales value including the tax amount exceeded PLN 200,000,000 in 2024.
rows.threshold_basis: Sales value including the tax amount (wartość sprzedaży wraz z kwotą podatku)
rows.threshold_period: calendar year 2024 — a fixed historical year, not a rolling period
rows.threshold_definition: The portal gates the first phase on sales exceeding "200 mln zł" in 2024. Because the reference year is fixed at 2024, a company cannot fall out of this phase by shrinking in 2025: whoever was above the line in 2024 is in the February cohort permanently.
rows.format_note: FA_RR(1) applies to agricultural invoices from April 2026.
rows.legal_instrument: Ustawa z dnia 5 sierpnia 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy o podatku od towarów i usług (Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203).
rows.source_title: "Podstawy prawne oraz kluczowe terminy" — legal basis and key dates, Ministry of Finance KSeF portal (ksef.podatki.gov.pl)
rows.confidence_note: Read directly on 2026-10-07: the 1 February 2026 date, the PLN 200 million threshold, the 2024 reference year, and the citing act Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203.
unknowns: Whether the PLN 200m test is measured on taxable sales only or on total sales including exempt supplies is not specified on the portal page read.
rows.notes: The February cohort is small in number but includes most large Polish groups and their suppliers' counterparties, so it drives supplier readiness well ahead of April.

rows.regime_label: National e-Invoice System (KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur)
rows.bound_party: All remaining VAT taxpayers — those whose 2024 sales value including the tax amount did not exceed PLN 200,000,000.
rows.threshold_basis: Sales value including the tax amount (wartość sprzedaży wraz z kwotą podatku)
rows.threshold_period: calendar year 2024 — a fixed historical year, not a rolling period
rows.threshold_definition: The residual cohort: everyone not caught by the PLN 200 million 2024 test. The portal describes this phase as "all remaining entrepreneurs" from 1 April 2026, subject to the PLN 10,000/month small-invoice transition recorded in tolerance_ends.
rows.format_note: FA_RR(1) applies to agricultural invoices from April 2026.
rows.tolerance_note: Small-invoice transition running to 31 December 2026. A taxpayer otherwise obliged to issue structured invoices may still issue electronic or paper invoices in a given month where the total value of sales including tax documented by those invoices is PLN 10,000 or less. Cash registers and fiscal receipts bearing the purchaser's NIP — treated as simplified invoices, up to PLN 450 or EUR 100 — also remain usable to 31 December 2026, as does the deferral of the duty to quote KSeF numbers in B2B payments.
rows.legal_instrument: Ustawa z dnia 5 sierpnia 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy o podatku od towarów i usług (Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203).
rows.source_title: "Podstawy prawne oraz kluczowe terminy" — legal basis and key dates, Ministry of Finance KSeF portal (ksef.podatki.gov.pl)
rows.confidence_note: Read directly on 2026-10-07: the 1 April 2026 date for remaining taxpayers, and the PLN 10,000 monthly small-invoice transition expiring at the end of 2026.
unknowns: Whether the PLN 10,000 monthly test is applied per month independently (so a taxpayer can move in and out of the transition month to month) or is forfeited permanently once breached is not stated on the portal page read.
rows.notes: Out of scope per the portal: B2C invoices (voluntary), foreign entities with no Polish seat or fixed establishment, invoices under OSS, IOSS and the SME exemption, certain transport and toll services, and self-invoicing where a party lacks a Polish NIP.

rows.regime_label: National e-Invoice System (KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur)
rows.bound_party: All VAT taxpayers in Poland, regardless of size.
rows.threshold_definition: No size test. The Ministry of Finance states receiving via KSeF is mandatory from 1 February 2026 "regardless of company size", which is two months before the small-taxpayer issuing duty starts.
rows.format_note: FA(3) is the logical structure for standard invoices. A separate FA_RR(1) structure applies to agricultural invoices from April 2026.
rows.legal_instrument: Ustawa z dnia 5 sierpnia 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy o podatku od towarów i usług (Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203), amending the Polish VAT Act.
rows.source_title: "Zakres obowiązkowego KSeF" — scope of the mandatory KSeF obligation, Ministry of Finance KSeF portal (ksef.podatki.gov.pl)
rows.confidence_note: Read directly on 2026-10-07 on the Ministry of Finance KSeF portal, which states "Receiving invoices using KSeF will be mandatory already from 1 February 2026" for all VAT taxpayers, and names FA(3) as the current logical structure.
unknowns: Whether a taxpayer relying on the PLN 10,000/month small-invoice transition for ISSUING is nonetheless obliged to receive via KSeF from 1 February 2026 is not stated in terms. Read literally the receiving duty is unconditional, but the interaction is not spelled out on the portal.
rows.notes: The asymmetry here is the commercially important fact: a small Polish company is in scope for receiving on 1 February 2026, two months before the headline "April 2026" issuing date that most summaries lead with.
